newsitem.title: INDIA: India's STC to decide on wheat tender soon.
newsitem.headline: India's STC to decide on wheat tender soon.

text.p: India's state-run State Trading Corporation (STC) said on Thursday it would decide in the next two days on offers received for its tender to import 50,000 tonnes of wheat.
"It will take one or two days to decide," a senior STC official told Reuters. "We have plenty of offers."
STC last week tendered for the wheat imports, due for shipments by the end of February and for arrival no later than March 31.
Earlier this month, senior STC officials said the corporation had separately contracted to import 1.25 million tonnes of wheat.
In December the federal government authorised the import of up to two million tonnes of wheat in 1996/97 (April-March) to increase supplies and check rising domestic prices.
